subject: gk
question: What does CJI stand for?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chief Justice of India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chief Justice of India** is the** head of the judiciary system** in India and the Supreme Court of India.
 
• The Chief Justice of India is **appointed by the President of India**.
 
• The CJI plays a crucial role in the appointment of judges to the Supreme Court and High Courts.
 
• The Chief Justice of India also administers the oath of office to the President of India.
 
• The CJI has significant administrative powers and responsibilities within the judiciary system of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first Chief Justice of India was **Harilal Jekisundas Kania**.
 
• The Supreme Court of India consists of the **Chief Justice and a maximum of 33 other judges**.
 
• The Chief Justice of India serves until the age of 65.
 
• The CJI can be impeached by Parliament for proven misbehavior or incapacity.
 
• The Chief Justice of India is also responsible for allocating cases and appointing constitutional benches to deal with important matters of law.
